title: Robot holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <rect x='32' y='48' width='36' height='30' rx='6' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x='35' y='51' width='10' height='24' rx='3' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <rect x='30' y='20' width='40' height='28' rx='8' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <rect x='34' y='23' width='10' height='18' rx='4' fill='#81D4FA'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='5' fill='#E0F7FA'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#00BCD4'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#00BCD4'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q50 47 56 42' stroke='#E0F7FA' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antenna -->
  <rect x='48' y='12' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='4' fill='#FF8A65'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <!-- Left arm reaching toward heart -->
  <rect x='20' y='55' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Right arm reaching toward heart -->
  <rect x='66' y='55' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <!-- Hands -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='58' r='4' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='4' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- Heart the robot holds -->
  <path d='M50 62 
           C50 56, 42 52, 40 58 
           C38 64, 50 74, 50 74 
           C50 74, 62 64, 60 58 
           C58 52, 50 56, 50 62 Z' 
        fill='#FF4081'/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d='M46 60 
           C46 57, 43 56, 43 59 
           C43 62, 47 66, 47 66 
           C47 66, 50 63, 49 60 
           C48 57, 46 58, 46 60 Z' 
        fill='#FF80AB'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <rect x='54' y='78' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#29B6F6'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFB74D'/>
  <rect x='52' y='86' width='14' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFB74D'/>
</svg>
